/.title: Academic Poster Maker for Researchers | Postr
/.description: A poster editor built for researchers. Print-ready conference sizes, figure readability checks, authors and affiliations, BibTeX citations.
copy: A poster editor that handles the fiddly parts — micro-edits, text that reflows when you resize, conference size specs, figures too small to read in print, authors and affiliations, BibTeX citations — so you can work on the science. Start with a conference-ready layout, then keep every design decision under your control.
Smart templates: conference-ready layouts with discipline-specific palettes, and APA, SfN and ECNP size presets built in.
Figure readability: paste your R or Python plotting code and see whether the axis labels will still be readable at print size, with a copy-ready fix.
Writing guide: section-by-section tips, word count targets, and a checklist to follow from intro to conclusion.

/about.title: How Postr Works: Features for Academic Posters
/about.description: See how Postr handles authors and affiliations, BibTeX citations, Greek symbols, print sizing, and figure readability: the parts other poster tools get wrong.
copy: Postr is a free academic poster editor for students and researchers. It exists because the usual tools were built for something else. Research structure, print constraints, and editable output stay in one focused workflow.
Enter institutions once, then click to assign them to authors. Superscript numbering stays in sync when you add or remove an affiliation.

Export a .bib from your reference manager and drop it in. Postr reads BibTeX, RIS and EndNote files and formats the reference list for you. The result remains editable without rebuilding citations by hand.
Every poster starts at a real print size, so what you see on screen is what the print shop actually produces at full scale.

/why-posters.title: Why Poster Sessions Matter: Skills That Outlast Them
/why-posters.description: Presenting a poster teaches explaining your work at three lengths, arguing visually, and handling questions live. Plus how to get more from one.
copy: Poster sessions have a reputation as the consolation prize of conference formats. That reading misses what the format is unusually good at.
A poster visit lasts anywhere from twenty seconds to twenty minutes, so you build a one-line version, a two-minute version, and the full walkthrough.
A poster has no room for the paragraph that rescues a confusing figure, so the layout has to carry the logic. That is editorial work, not decoration.
Committee meetings, peer review, and interviews all run on answering questions in real time. A poster session is a low-stakes place to learn it.
You cannot fit the project on the board, so you decide the one claim the poster defends. Framing early, on a deadline, is unusually good practice.

/pricing.title: Postr Pricing: Free Poster Maker, Paid Export
/pricing.description: Editing and PDF export are always free. Export to PowerPoint & LaTeX with the CA$18.99 term (every 4 months, cancel anytime) or a one-time CA$9.99 export pack.
/pricing.h1: Free to build. Pay only to take it further.
copy: A finished, print-ready poster costs nothing on Postr. Editing and PDF export are always free, with a small "made with postr.sh" mark. No card or account is required to finish and print your work.
The CA$18.99 term unlocks unlimited PowerPoint and LaTeX export with no watermark. It renews every four months and you can cancel anytime.
The CA$9.99 pack exports three posters to PowerPoint or LaTeX — a one-time purchase whose credits never expire, for anyone who doesn't need a full term.
You only pay to export to PowerPoint or LaTeX. The free poster workflow — editor, tools, and watermarked PDF — has no limits.

/chart-chooser.title: Chart Chooser: Which Chart Fits Your Data? | Postr
/chart-chooser.description: Paste a table or answer three short questions and get ranked, journal-style chart suggestions with captions. Download SVG or PNG. Free, no signup.
copy: Paste a table, upload a CSV or Excel file, or answer three short questions — the chooser ranks the figures that fit your data, drawn as journal-style panels with captions. Download any panel as SVG or PNG. Free, no account, and your data never leaves the browser.
Every suggestion explains itself in methods voice: what shape your data has, and why that chart form reads more accurately than the alternatives.
No data yet? Walk through the three questions and start from a worked example with believable numbers, then swap in your own.
Need the figure on a conference poster? Postr is a free academic poster editor with the same chart engine built in, plus a print-readability check for figures you already have.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy for Postr Researchers
/privacy.description: How Postr collects, stores, and protects your data, including anonymous sessions, poster documents, and cookies. Plain language, no dark patterns.
copy: Postr collects account details and poster documents only when needed to provide, secure, and support the service. You control your research content, and private posters are not used to train models.
Anonymous editor sessions use essential authentication storage. Page counting is cookieless, creates no advertising profile, and does not assign a persistent visitor identifier.
Hosting, authentication, payment, email, and operations providers receive only the data required for their role, subject to contractual and technical safeguards.

You may request access, correction, export, or deletion of personal data. The full privacy policy explains retention, international processing, security, legal bases, children's privacy, policy changes, complaints, and how to contact Postr with a question or request.

/privacy/fr.title: Politique de confidentialité de Postr
/privacy/fr.description: Découvrez comment Postr collecte, utilise, protège et supprime vos renseignements personnels, y compris les comptes, affiches, témoins et fournisseurs.
copy: Postr recueille les renseignements de compte et les documents d’affiche nécessaires pour fournir, sécuriser et soutenir le service. Vous gardez le contrôle de votre contenu de recherche.

Les sessions anonymes utilisent un stockage d’authentification essentiel. Le comptage des pages fonctionne sans témoins, sans profil publicitaire et sans identifiant persistant attribué aux visiteurs.

Les fournisseurs d’hébergement, d’authentification, de paiement, de courriel et d’exploitation reçoivent uniquement les données requises pour leur rôle, avec des garanties contractuelles et techniques.

Vous pouvez demander l’accès, la rectification, l’exportation ou la suppression de vos renseignements. La politique complète explique la conservation, les transferts internationaux, la sécurité, les plaintes et les coordonnées.

/cookies.title: Cookie Policy and Analytics | Postr
/cookies.description: What Postr stores on your device and what it does not. Essential authentication only — page counting is cookieless, with no persistent identifier.
copy: Postr uses essential browser storage to maintain signed-in and anonymous editor sessions, protect accounts, remember the poster currently being edited, and keep requested features working between page loads.

Page views are counted without cookies, advertising profiles, fingerprinting, cross-site tracking, or an identifier that persists between visits. Postr does not use optional analytics or advertising cookies.
Payment providers may set storage required to complete checkout, prevent fraud, verify a transaction, and manage billing. Their own policies govern that limited provider-controlled storage.

Blocking essential storage can prevent sign-in, saving, checkout, export access, or other requested features. The full policy lists each storage category, purpose, duration, responsible provider, and available browser control in plain language.

/cookies/fr.title: Politique relative aux témoins | Postr
/cookies/fr.description: Découvrez le stockage essentiel utilisé par Postr pour les sessions et paiements, ainsi que l’analyse sans témoins, profil publicitaire ni suivi persistant.
copy: Postr utilise le stockage essentiel du navigateur pour maintenir les sessions connectées et anonymes, protéger les comptes, mémoriser l’affiche ouverte et conserver les fonctions demandées.
Les pages sont comptées sans témoins, profil publicitaire, empreinte numérique, suivi intersite ou identifiant persistant. Postr n’utilise aucun témoin facultatif d’analyse ou de publicité.
Les fournisseurs de paiement peuvent définir le stockage requis pour effectuer une transaction, prévenir la fraude et gérer la facturation. Leurs politiques encadrent ce stockage limité.

Bloquer le stockage essentiel peut empêcher la connexion, l’enregistrement, le paiement ou l’accès aux exportations. La politique complète précise chaque catégorie, finalité, durée, fournisseur et contrôle disponible.

Use Postr lawfully and only with content you have permission to use. Respect intellectual property, personal privacy, platform security, and other users.

Utilisez Postr légalement et seulement avec du contenu que vous êtes autorisé à employer. Respectez la propriété intellectuelle, la vie privée, la sécurité et les autres utilisateurs.

Les fonctions gratuites et payantes peuvent changer, et une disponibilité ininterrompue n’est pas garantie. Les paiements, renouvellements, annulations, remboursements et exportations suivent les conditions affichées.

/paper-to-poster.title: Paper to Poster: Turn a Manuscript into One | Postr
/paper-to-poster.description: Turn a paper into a conference poster. Paste your manuscript or upload a Word document, answer a few short questions, and download a poster draft as a PDF.
copy: Turn a paper into a conference poster draft. Paste your manuscript or upload a .docx, answer a few short questions about what to emphasise, and download the poster — no editor session required.

The draft follows the structure conference posters actually need: a hook, the research question, only the methods a reader needs to trust the result, one to three key findings, and a take-home message, each with a hard word budget.
You choose the emphasis: the finding to lead with, the audience, what the poster is for, and any section that must not be cut.
Check the outline before you download — every panel shows which manuscript section it came from. Export a print-ready PDF, or a .postr file to keep editing in Postr.

/paper-to-slides.title: Paper to Slides: Turn a Manuscript into a Deck | Postr
/paper-to-slides.description: Turn a paper into an editable slide deck. Paste a manuscript or upload a Word file, answer a few short questions, and download a free PDF or a PowerPoint.
copy: Turn a paper into a slide deck. Paste your manuscript or upload a .docx, answer a few short questions about your talk, and build an ordered deck — no editor session required.

The deck follows the arc a research talk needs: the most important result first, the gap and tension it resolves, then methods and figures as fill-ins. One finding per slide, each under a hard word budget so the slide never competes with the speaker.
Every slide carries speaker notes taken from your paper, each showing which section it came from, so nothing on a slide is invented.
Your manuscript is never stored on our servers and is never used to train models. Download a free PDF, or an editable PowerPoint you can open in PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides, or LibreOffice.
